text:
amal: Heads-up — dev uploaded a core/debug bundle to gs://adhoc-debug/2026-06-02/host-21-core.tgz and it contains a VAULT_TOKEN and an SA JSON. Marking P0 for containment and rotation. :rotating_light:

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-487 created and oncall paged.

marta: Can you paste a masked grep so we can scope quickly (no raw secrets)?

amal: Masked snippet below:

```
VAULT_TOKEN=***vault-xxxx***
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/ci-sa.json
{"type": "service_account", "project_id": "redwood-ci", "private_key_id": "***", "private_key": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\\n***\\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}
```

amal: Note: the bucket had a 7d lifecycle but was accidentally set to allow org-viewers (includes two external contractors).

darius: Triage playbook: 1) Revoke Vault accessor immediately and invalidate issued leases. 2) Delete the exposed SA key and issue a new key with minimal roles. 3) Short TTL for new key and store in Vault with a lease. 4) Rewrap any ciphertext encrypted with legacy-KMS; schedule transit key rekey if used. 5) Tighten GCS IAM and set lifecycle to 12h, enable uniform bucket-level access and object change logs. 6) Turn on verbose Vault audit sink for 14d (capture full json).

ops-oncall: Running commands now — will post outputs (masked):

```
vault token-revoke -accessor "***accessor***"  # revoked
vault lease-revoke -prefix <prefix>             # cleaned leases
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEYID --iam-account=debug-agent@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-ci  # deleted
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=debug-agent@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-ci  # created
```

ops-oncall: Completed revoke/delete/create. New key uploaded to Vault at secret/debug/new-key with 30m TTL.

kai: I'll run an audit sweep: Vault audit and GCP admin activity for the last 72h to see token usage and SA activity.

marta: Quick audit results: Vault audit shows token-lookup and one KV read under secret/data/dev/experiment-flags (non-prod). No accesses to secret/data/prod-* paths. GCP admin logs show SA used to PUT object to the bucket at 2026-06-02T04:18Z.

darius: Good — still proceed with rewrap of any objects created by legacy-KMS-03. If transit keys were used by internal services, schedule rekey ASAP and treat ciphertext as at-risk until rewrap complete. I'll start the rewrap job and file a maintenance ticket to rotate transit-KMS-03 after confirmation.

kai: Also found two refused IAM attempts from an external IP when accessing the bucket; looks like someone tried to list objects but was denied. I set an alert for any allow-list changes.

marta: RBAC change plan: remove broad storage roles from debug-agent SA, grant storage.objectCreator + storage.objects.get scoped to gs://adhoc-debug only. I will open the PR and request an expedited review.

ops-oncall: PR merged and IAM patched. Also enforced uniform bucket-level access and set lifecycle to 12h. Object change logs enabled and exported to central logging for 14d retention.

amal: Action items recap and owners:
- revoke exposed token + revoke leases (ops-oncall) — done
- delete exposed SA key + create scoped key in Vault (ops-oncall) — done
- schedule transit rekey & rewrap legacy-KMS-03 (darius) — in progress
- RBAC scoping PR for debug-agent SA (marta) — merged
- enable verbose Vault audit sink -> central store (marta) — in progress
- tighten bucket lifecycle to 12h and block org-public access (ops-oncall/marta) — done

security-bot: Linked incident page: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-487 (audit ids attached).

darius: Rewrap finished for artifacts encrypted with legacy-KMS-03. Filing follow-up to rotate transit-KMS-03 keys in the next maintenance window (ETA 4h).

kai: Audit deep-dive: no prod secret reads. Two denied list attempts from an external IP were logged and blocked. I elevated those IPs to the watchlist and added a firewall rule suggestion for infra.

marta: Postmortem plan: 45-minute blameless session tomorrow 11:30 PT. Topics: debug-agent default behavior (scrub env vars), artifact lifecycle defaults, and CI catalog of allowed buckets. Prospect remediation: agent-level scrubbing, default TTL 24h, and pre-upload validation to reject any file with "VAULT_TOKEN" or "private_key" patterns.

amal: Thanks all. Updating INC-2026-487 with timeline, owners, and links to PRs & logs. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
